cards.gloss_en: too great to be put into words
cards.ex_en: Her joy was inexpressible.
He was fatigued after the long walk.

cards.gloss_en: authority to act for another person
cards.ex_en: He signed the papers by procuration.
cards.ex_cn: 他通过委托代理签署了文件。

cards.ex_en: Milk is a wholesome drink.
cards.ex_cn: 牛奶是有益健康的饮品。

cards.ex_en: She disposed of the old books.
A fleet of ships left the port.

cards.gloss_en: someone you know but not a close friend
cards.ex_en: He is an old acquaintance of mine.

cards.gloss_en: too much; to a very great degree
cards.ex_en: He talks excessively at meetings.

cards.gloss_en: agree or promise to do something
cards.ex_en: She will undertake the new project.

cards.gloss_en: the flat part at a boat's back used to steer
cards.ex_en: The rudder helps steer the boat.

cards.gloss_en: putting to death; also the carrying out of a task
cards.ex_en: The plan was good in its execution.
He endeavoured to finish on time.
The horse ran with great swiftness.

cards.gloss_en: flowed back away from the land
cards.ex_en: The tide ebbed in the evening.

cards.gloss_en: stuck on the bottom in shallow water
cards.ex_en: The boat ran aground on the sand.
He ate the remainder of the cake.

cards.gloss_en: a sleeveless garment worn under a coat
cards.ex_en: He wore a waistcoat under his coat.

cards.gloss_en: large round wooden containers for liquids
cards.ex_en: The casks were full of wine.

cards.gloss_en: a store of supplies or ammunition
cards.ex_en: They stored powder in the magazine.
cards.ex_cn: 他们把火药存在弹药库里。

cards.ex_en: The barrel was full of gunpowder.

cards.gloss_en: a straight line across a circle through its centre
cards.ex_en: The circle has a diameter of ten centimetres.
cards.ex_cn: 这个圆的直径是十厘米。

cards.ex_en: He applied himself to his studies.

cards.gloss_en: a time when day and night are equal in length
cards.ex_en: Day and night are equal at the equinox.

cards.gloss_en: flat floating structures used as boats
cards.ex_en: They built rafts to cross the river.
She made remarkable progress.

cards.gloss_en: heavy sticky earth used to make pots
cards.ex_en: The pot is made of clay.
cards.ex_cn: 这个罐子是用黏土做的。

cards.ex_en: He concealed the key under a rock.
cards.ex_cn: 他把钥匙藏在石头下面。

cards.ex_en: She was loath to leave home.

cards.gloss_en: a turtle or tortoise (here a sea turtle)
cards.ex_en: The tortoise moved very slowly.

cards.gloss_en: the act of asking or investigating
cards.ex_en: He made an inquiry about the train.
She won the child's affections.
They paddled the periagua to shore.
cards.ex_cn: 他们把独木舟划向岸边。

cards.gloss_en: to move a boat into the water
cards.ex_en: They will launch the new boat today.
cards.ex_cn: 他们今天要让新船下水。

cards.ex_en: He felt assured of success.
She felt abhorrence at the cruel act.
cards.ex_cn: 她对这残忍的行为深感厌恶。

cards.ex_en: All his relations came to the party.
cards.ex_cn: 他所有的亲戚都来参加聚会了。

cards.gloss_en: to try hard to do something
cards.ex_en: We must endeavour to do our best.
He mastered his fear and went on.
cards.ex_cn: 他克制住恐惧,继续前行。

cards.ex_en: They reckoned the road was safe.
cards.ex_cn: 他们认为这条路是安全的。

cards.ex_en: The boat shipped water in the storm.
He acknowledged his mistake.
She treated the poor with humanity.
A great loss had befallen them.
cards.ex_cn: 一场大祸降临到他们身上。

cards.gloss_en: to guide the direction of a boat or vehicle
cards.ex_en: He steered the boat to the shore.
We had mutton for dinner.
The birds flew southward for winter.
For aught I know, he may be right.
cards.ex_cn: 据我所知,他也许是对的。

suspect.ctx: so we worked at the oar towards the land, though with heavy hearts, like men going to execution
suspect.issue: 书里是 "like men going to execution"(如赴刑场/赴死),现释义 "执行;实施" 回读完全不通——此处 execution 指处决/行刑
suspect.suggest: 加义项 "(死刑的)处决;行刑",如 going to execution=走向刑场/赴死

suspect.ctx: Going down to the seaside, I found a large tortoise or turtle.
suspect.issue: 书里在海边发现的 "tortoise or turtle" 实为海龟,现释义 "陆龟" 偏窄、易误导(陆龟不在海边)
suspect.suggest: 放宽为 "龟;(此处指)海龟" 或泛指 "龟类"

suspect.ctx: She sailed with what we call a shoulder-of-mutton sail
suspect.issue: 书里 mutton 出现在固定航海词 "shoulder-of-mutton sail"(三角帆,因形似羊肩肉块得名),"羊肉" 无法帮读者理解此处用法
suspect.suggest: 保留 "羊肉" 本义,可加注 shoulder-of-mutton sail 为三角帆的固定说法
